rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for money earned and money received by a fund, account, or policy.

example.english: My income is enough to cover rent and food every month.
example.traditional: 我每個月嘅收入都夠交租同食飯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 go3 jyut6 ge3 sau1 jap6 dou1 gau3 gaau1 zou1 tung4 sik6 faan6
